hero.title: Precision that shapes the land.
hero.lede: Geodesy, land surveying and land development by a professional team with more than {{years}} years of experience: accurate measurements, modern technology and documentation you can rely on.
hero.imageAlt: Sunrise over dark mountain ridges with fog filling the valleys

intro.title: Every plan starts with a measured point.
paragraphs: MAES17 works where land, property and construction meet. We measure terrain and structures, establish coordinates and prepare the drawings and documents that owners, designers and builders depend on.
Our approach is simple: understand what the measurement is for, choose the method that delivers the required accuracy, and document the result so it can be checked and reused.
intro.imageAlt: Mountain range in which half of the terrain is shown as a digital wireframe model

services.title: Services
services.lede: From control networks to final as-built documentation, each service is scoped to the decision it has to support.

method.title: How a survey comes together
method.lede: Fieldwork, instruments and office processing follow one continuous, documented chain.

steps.title: Brief and existing documents
steps.text: We clarify the purpose of the work, review available plans, titles and previous surveys, and agree the scope and deliverables.

steps.title: Reconnaissance and control
steps.text: The site is inspected and reference points are established or recovered, so every later measurement ties to a known coordinate system.

steps.title: Field measurement
steps.text: Terrain, boundaries or structures are measured with methods suited to the site, such as satellite positioning or total station observations.

steps.title: Processing and drafting
steps.text: Observations are checked, adjusted and turned into plans, terrain models, coordinate lists and drawings.

steps.title: Delivery and support
steps.text: You receive the agreed documents and files, with explanations of what they show and how they can be used next.

technology.title: Technology in service of accuracy
technology.lede: Instruments only matter when the results are checked. We combine field equipment with careful processing and clear documentation.

items.title: Satellite positioning
items.text: GNSS observations for control points and open terrain, tied to the coordinate system the project requires.

items.title: Total station measurement
items.text: Angle and distance measurement for detailed surveys, structures and setting-out where line of sight is available.

items.title: Digital terrain models
items.text: Surface models and contour plans prepared from field data for design, earthworks and volume calculations.

items.title: CAD and GIS deliverables
items.text: Drawings and spatial data delivered in formats agreed with you and your designers.

technology.note: Specific equipment and expected accuracy are stated in the proposal for each project.
